questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Is part of the erasmus mundus programme. I choose warsaw instead of milano because i wanted to learn things regarding sustainability, livelihoods and governance

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Really difficult. Poland is not an easy country, they don´t like foreigners and some even refuse to help you if you don´t speak english.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We had the welcome point from the university

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Difficult, prices were high for being in poland and in my case i had to pay extra to register in a reliable housing portal. Some of my classmates tried from facebook groups and found something, but i thought it was risky

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Warsaw´s campus is way too big and is everywhere in the city. You are for sure going to expend at least 1 day 1 hour (one way) in public transport if you have to go to 3 different campus for your studies.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: We had no courses, they were already completed.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We received an email to do it one day. That day we received another email it was postpone to the next day. When we tried to join courses they were already full. They had to open the possibility for new courses so we could have enough ects. Also half of the courses that in which we could register didn´t even exists

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Not good one. Administration was too slow trying to solve things because they also needed to fix things with KU

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: In the end i could register in every course i wanted, but in the begining i was attending the classes "hoping" that i could register and have enough ects

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Talk to the teachers first if they would accept one more student in their classes and then write the adminstration

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I had more content in my first year of bachellor than in this second year master

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Just a note. Eventhout we were second year master students, the course was offer to bachellor students so the level was not suitable for us. 
Courses were easy, no new content, not going deep. It seems that the only thing they new about sustainability was the SDGs and they repeated in every single course. Some professor even did their presentations with ai.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I like in UCPH that there was a lot of discussion between us and with the professors. In warsaw is just the professors showing slides and talking. Some courses proposed elaborate activities together as a final exam.f

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

Forget what you think about academic institutions
Be patient
Everything is going to be all right
